body: GITHUB HUGGING FACE MODELSCOPE KAGGLE DEMO DISCORD Introduction Today, we are excited to open source the “Powerful”, “Diverse”, and “Practical” Qwen2.5-Coder series, dedicated to continuously promoting the development of Open CodeLLMs. Powerful: Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct has become the current SOTA open-source code model, matching the coding capabilities of GPT-4o. While demonstrating strong and comprehensive coding abilities, it also possesses good general and mathematical skills; Diverse: Building on the previously open-sourced two sizes of 1.
summaryZh: 通义千问正式开源Qwen2.5-Coder系列代码大模型，包含多个尺寸。其中的Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct表现卓越，在代码生成、修复等任务上达到了当前开源代码大模型的SOTA水平，其编程能力可比肩GPT-4o，同时兼具通用和数学能力。

glossary.explanationZh: 专门针对软件编程、代码生成与调试任务优化的大语言模型。
State-of-the-Art，指当前同类技术或模型中的最高水平。
大模型除了专业领域之外所具备的常识和通用语言处理能力。
模型处理数学计算和逻辑推理题目的能力。
